main.description: Take the named cluster's control plane down: flip its desired state to not-running and dematerialise the process group. The store is RETAINED - the objects, the S3 prefix and the OpenBao path all survive, so a later controlPlaneUp resumes the same cluster. Idempotent: calling it on a cluster that is already down is a success. Ordering is load-bearing and belongs to the materialiser, not to the caller: phase goes Unavailable first, the tenant path is asserted shut, and only then is the process group reaped in reverse.

name.description: The cluster label, unique within the calling account.

phase.description: The phase the cluster is heading to. Unavailable means the teardown order has been accepted; it is asynchronous and this response does not wait for it.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Name absent, or not a legal RFC-1123 label within 63 characters.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.description: Missing or invalid service-auth token. Also returned when the token's aud is not this service or its lxm is not this method.

errors.name: ClusterNotFound
errors.description: This account has no cluster of that name. Deliberately indistinguishable from a name that belongs to another account.
